firm_data.firm_description: Licatesi Law Group, LLP, established in 1981, is a Long Island law firm with offices in Uniondale and Brooklyn, serving clients throughout the five boroughs of New York City, as well as Nassau and Suffolk counties. The firm focuses on personal injury cases, medical malpractice, and no-fault insurance disputes.

email.subject: AI for Licatesi Law Group, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Michael,

Licatesi's focus on complex medical malpractice and no-fault disputes across NYC and Long Island caught my attention. Cases like yours demand precision work under pressure, and most tools built for BigLaw miss what smaller, specialized firms actually need.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of your practice: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by your Uniondale office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping firms like yours compete without losing quality.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
